tasks.title: Freeze candidate metadata for one resolution transaction
tasks.goal: Prevent mutable same-version metadata and repeated discovery from changing a solve.
steps: Bind candidate manifests to exact source/content/definition identity rather than version alone.
Create one immutable catalog view for a transaction and cache candidate capabilities within it.
Make missing/corrupt catalog data distinct from a candidate lacking a requested option.
positive_cases: Repeated metadata access in one solve returns the same candidate definition.
negative_cases: Same-version content replacement cannot mutate the in-flight catalog.
Discarded candidate metadata cannot trigger a global selection prompt.
acceptance: Catalog identity is reproducible and inspected through ETO.
Source corruption and candidate incompatibility have different outcomes.
tasks.safe_stop: Return unavailable/corrupt catalog before any install effects.
notes: Internal children execute sequentially; cross-parent prerequisites remain exactly the root campaign graph.

tasks.title: Make activation candidate-conditioned and backtrackable
tasks.goal: Scope feature and choice implications to the candidate that introduced them.
steps: Attach activation implications and induced requirements to selected candidate literals or an equivalent complete encoding.
Preserve each incoming consumer request/constraint through candidate rejection.
Bind default-based selections to shown exact definitions; changed semantic default requires rediscovery, never automatic backtracking selection.
positive_cases: Solver rejects incompatible newest and accepts an older compatible candidate.
negative_cases: Rejected candidate leaves no active features/providers/dependency effects.
Mandatory unresolved group on an unreachable candidate never prompts.
acceptance: Counterexample fixtures compare selected graph and all derived activation effects.
Conflict evidence retains the consumer and candidate reasons.
tasks.safe_stop: Unsupported combinations refuse before mutation; no bounded retry masquerades as completeness.

tasks.title: Use normalized requests across every solve route
tasks.goal: Prevent visibility retry and metadata paths from losing constraints or selected edges.
steps: Thread the same immutable request/catalog through solve, manifest_of, solve_masked and conditional/visibility routes.
Retain all root constraints and actual capability/OR-provider choices in the final graph.
Expose backend capability refusal without fallback; keep incomplete conditional combinations explicitly unsupported.
positive_cases: Visibility retry preserves the same consumer requests and exact choices as initial solving.
negative_cases: First-wins dedup, reconstructed old manifest or unsupported backend cannot silently drop requested effects.
acceptance: Route parity fixtures produce identical selected graph or equivalent typed conflicts.
Every graph edge has a selected declaration/provider provenance.
tasks.safe_stop: Do not apply a graph assembled from inconsistent solve routes.
